question: How many vessels are in the fleet today?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM network.vessels WHERE in_fleet_to IS NULL

question: What is the total TEU capacity of the current fleet?
sql: SELECT SUM(teu_capacity) FROM network.vessels WHERE in_fleet_to IS NULL

question: How many vessels are owned versus chartered?
sql: SELECT ownership, COUNT(*) FROM network.vessels GROUP BY ownership

question: How many ships of each fuel type are in the current fleet?
sql: SELECT fuel_type, COUNT(*) FROM network.vessels WHERE in_fleet_to IS NULL GROUP BY fuel_type

question: List our services with their trade lane.
sql: SELECT service_code, lane_code FROM network.services

question: How many ports on our service rotations are in each region?
sql: SELECT p.region, COUNT(DISTINCT p.port_code) FROM network.ports p WHERE p.port_code IN (SELECT port_code FROM network.service_rotations) GROUP BY p.region

question: How many voyages sailed via the Cape of Good Hope?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM network.voyages WHERE routing = 'cape_of_good_hope'

question: How many voyages did each service complete in 2025?
sql: SELECT service_code, COUNT(*) FROM network.voyages WHERE status = 'completed' AND departure_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND departure_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY service_code

question: What was overall schedule reliability in each year?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pc.scheduled_arrival), ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN pc.actual_arrival <= pc.scheduled_arrival + INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 4) FROM network.port_calls pc WHERE pc.seq > 1 AND pc.actual_arrival IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

question: What was schedule reliability by trade lane in Q1 2024?
sql: SELECT s.lane_code, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN pc.actual_arrival <= pc.scheduled_arrival + INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 4) FROM network.port_calls pc JOIN network.voyages v ON v.voyage_id = pc.voyage_id JOIN network.services s ON s.service_code = v.service_code WHERE pc.seq > 1 AND pc.actual_arrival IS NOT NULL AND pc.scheduled_arrival >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01' AND pc.scheduled_arrival < TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-04-01' GROUP BY s.lane_code

question: Which five ports had the most container moves overall?
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(pc.container_moves) AS moves FROM network.port_calls pc JOIN network.ports p ON p.port_code = pc.port_code GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY moves DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

question: What is the average time in port per call at Rotterdam, in hours?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (actual_departure - actual_arrival)) / 3600)::numeric, 1) FROM network.port_calls WHERE port_code = 'NLRTM' AND actual_arrival IS NOT NULL

question: How many customers do we have in each segment?
sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) FROM commercial.customers GROUP BY segment

question: How many customers are based in China?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commercial.customers WHERE country = 'China'

question: How many bookings were made in 2025, including cancelled ones?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commercial.bookings WHERE booking_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND booking_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: What was total TEU volume in 2025, excluding cancelled bookings?
sql: SELECT SUM(teu) FROM commercial.bookings WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND cargo_ready_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND cargo_ready_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: What was ocean freight revenue by trade lane in 2025?
sql: SELECT s.lane_code, ROUND(SUM(b.freight_revenue_usd), 2) FROM commercial.bookings b JOIN network.services s ON s.service_code = b.service_code WHERE b.status <> 'cancelled' AND b.cargo_ready_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND b.cargo_ready_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY s.lane_code

question: What was freight revenue per TEU by quarter on Asia - North Europe since 2024?
sql: SELECT date_trunc('quarter', b.cargo_ready_date), ROUND(SUM(b.freight_revenue_usd) / SUM(b.teu), 2) FROM commercial.bookings b JOIN network.services s ON s.service_code = b.service_code WHERE s.lane_code = 'AEU' AND b.status <> 'cancelled' AND b.cargo_ready_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY 1

question: How many bookings are in each status?
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM commercial.bookings GROUP BY status

question: What share of bookings were cancelled?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 4) FROM commercial.bookings

question: How many non-cancelled bookings with a 2024 cargo ready date were rolled at least once, by trade lane code?
sql: SELECT s.lane_code, COUNT(*) FROM commercial.bookings b JOIN network.services s ON s.service_code = b.service_code WHERE b.rolled_count > 0 AND b.status <> 'cancelled' AND b.cargo_ready_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND b.cargo_ready_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY s.lane_code

question: What were the top 5 commodities by TEU in 2025?
sql: SELECT commodity, SUM(teu) AS teu FROM commercial.bookings WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND cargo_ready_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND cargo_ready_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY commodity ORDER BY teu DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many non-cancelled reefer bookings were there each year since 2024 (by cargo ready date)?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cargo_ready_date), COUNT(*) FROM commercial.bookings WHERE is_reefer AND status <> 'cancelled' AND cargo_ready_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY 1

question: How many dangerous goods bookings were made in 2026, including cancelled ones?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commercial.bookings WHERE is_hazardous AND booking_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND booking_date < DATE '2027-01-01'

question: How much 2025 TEU was shipped under contract versus spot?
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN contract_id IS NULL THEN 'spot' ELSE 'contract' END, SUM(teu) FROM commercial.bookings WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND cargo_ready_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND cargo_ready_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1

question: Who were the top 5 customers by TEU in 2025?
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(b.teu) AS teu FROM commercial.bookings b JOIN commercial.customers c ON c.customer_id = b.customer_id WHERE b.status <> 'cancelled' AND b.cargo_ready_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND b.cargo_ready_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY teu DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many contracts started in 2026, by lane code?
sql: SELECT lane_code, COUNT(*) FROM commercial.contracts WHERE start_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND start_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY lane_code

question: How many bookings (including cancelled) were made per day from 8 to 18 June 2025?
sql: SELECT booking_date, COUNT(*) FROM commercial.bookings WHERE booking_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-08' AND DATE '2025-06-18' GROUP BY booking_date

question: How many containers do we have by type?
sql: SELECT container_type, COUNT(*) FROM equipment.containers GROUP BY container_type

question: How many containers are leased from each lessor?
sql: SELECT lessor, COUNT(*) FROM equipment.containers WHERE ownership = 'leased' GROUP BY lessor

question: How many booked containers have no seal number recorded?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commercial.booking_containers WHERE seal_number IS NULL

question: How many tracking events of each type are in the warehouse?
sql: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) FROM equipment.tracking_events GROUP BY event_type

question: What is the total amount invoiced in 2025?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_usd), 2) FROM finance.invoices WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: How many invoices are in each status?
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM finance.invoices GROUP BY status

question: What is the total overdue invoice amount?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_usd), 2) FROM finance.invoices WHERE status = 'overdue'

question: What was the average number of days to pay for invoices issued and paid in 2025?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(paid_date - invoice_date), 2) FROM finance.invoices WHERE status = 'paid' AND invoice_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: How much contingency surcharge (CTG) did we invoice in 2024?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(l.amount_usd), 2) FROM finance.invoice_lines l JOIN finance.invoices i ON i.invoice_id = l.invoice_id WHERE l.charge_code = 'CTG' AND i.invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01'

question: What was the total invoiced per charge code in 2025?
sql: SELECT l.charge_code, ROUND(SUM(l.amount_usd), 2) FROM finance.invoice_lines l JOIN finance.invoices i ON i.invoice_id = l.invoice_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY l.charge_code

question: What was the average price paid per tonne of VLSFO each year, weighted by quantity bought?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM purchase_date), ROUND(SUM(price_usd_per_mt * quantity_mt) / SUM(quantity_mt), 2) FROM finance.bunker_purchases WHERE fuel_grade = 'VLSFO' GROUP BY 1

question: How much did we spend on bunker fuel in 2025?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(price_usd_per_mt * quantity_mt), 2) FROM finance.bunker_purchases WHERE purchase_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND purchase_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: How many claims of each type were filed in 2025?
sql: SELECT claim_type, COUNT(*) FROM finance.claims WHERE filed_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND filed_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY claim_type

question: How many claims were caused by the faulty Coldline reefer controllers, and how much was settled in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(settled_amount_usd), 2) FROM finance.claims WHERE root_cause LIKE 'Faulty reefer controller%'

question: What share of claims were rejected?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'rejected' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 4) FROM finance.claims

question: How many delay incidents were logged per cause in 2024?
sql: SELECT cause, COUNT(*) FROM operations.delay_incidents WHERE started_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01' AND started_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01' GROUP BY cause

question: Which port had the most delay incidents?
sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM operations.delay_incidents d JOIN network.ports p ON p.port_code = d.port_code GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many critical delay incidents were there each year?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM started_at), COUNT(*) FROM operations.delay_incidents WHERE severity = 'critical' GROUP BY 1

question: What were total fleet CO2 emissions per year?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v.departure_date), ROUND(SUM(e.co2_tonnes), 1) FROM operations.voyage_emissions e JOIN network.voyages v ON v.voyage_id = e.voyage_id GROUP BY 1

question: How many EU ETS allowances were due for voyages departing in 2025?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(e.eu_ets_allowances), 1) FROM operations.voyage_emissions e JOIN network.voyages v ON v.voyage_id = e.voyage_id WHERE v.departure_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.departure_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: What was average headhaul vessel utilisation by service in 2025?
sql: SELECT v.service_code, ROUND(AVG(e.teu_carried::numeric / vs.teu_capacity), 4) FROM operations.voyage_emissions e JOIN network.voyages v ON v.voyage_id = e.voyage_id JOIN network.vessels vs ON vs.vessel_id = v.vessel_id WHERE v.direction = 'headhaul' AND v.departure_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.departure_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY v.service_code

question: What is the average trucking job cost by leg?
sql: SELECT leg, ROUND(AVG(cost_usd), 2) FROM operations.trucking_jobs GROUP BY leg

question: How many subcontractors of each type do we use?
sql: SELECT service_type, COUNT(*) FROM operations.subcontractors GROUP BY service_type

question: How many pallets were in stock across all logistics centres on the latest snapshot?
sql: SELECT SUM(pallets) FROM operations.inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM operations.inventory_snapshots)
